title: dev/update_changelog.py: batched GraphQL PR fetch skips NOT_FOUND nodes for issue references and raises on other errors
answers: Changelog generation aborts with a GraphQL error when a commit message references an issue number like (#24763)
Why does update_changelog.py fail on a release range that includes an issue reference?
How does the release changelog script handle errors returned by the GitHub GraphQL API?
Where is the changelog script's PR metadata fetch handled?
body:
Path: dev/update_changelog.py:_fetch_pr_chunk_graphql takes a chunk of PR numbers from the release commit range (the "#NNNN" references in commit messages) and fetches their metadata in one batched GraphQL request for the changelog section.
Rule: Treat a GraphQL response with an `errors` key as partial data. Errors whose type is NOT_FOUND mean the number is not a PR (typically an issue) and are logged as a warning and skipped; any other error type is re-raised as an Exception. The per-PR loop then simply lacks a node for the skipped number.
Symptom: Running the changelog generator for a release range aborted entirely with "GraphQL errors: ..." when one referenced number was an issue, so no CHANGELOG section was produced.
Constraints: Applies to the batched PR fetch in this script only. Do not swallow non-NOT_FOUND errors, since those indicate real failures. Prior ranges that referenced only PRs never hit this branch.
applies: Changelog/release tooling in dev/ that queries GitHub GraphQL for PR metadata from commit references.
says: Release changelog generation fails when a commit message references an issue number.
Generating release notes aborts completely if any referenced ticket number is not found.
Skip missing pull request records and continue creating the release notes section.
Release preparation script stops with an API error on non-pull-request ticket links.
Ignore issue links during changelog generation while still reporting genuine connection errors.
search: Release changelog generation in dev/update_changelog.py:_fetch_pr_chunk_graphql skips GraphQL NOT_FOUND errors while re-raising any other error types. Skipping NOT_FOUND entries allows the script to continue when commit references point to issue numbers instead of pull requests, preventing the generator from aborting the entire CHANGELOG section. Applies strictly to batched PR metadata queries in this release script and does not suppress non-NOT_FOUND failures.
